meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Every segment of the overnight and term money market each day since July 2020: call, notice, term, TREPS, market repo and repo in corporate bonds, with amounts and rates
meta.note: RBI, Money Market (daily Money Market Operations, DBIE report 611; the same table as report 659), market segments. Where the table prints a day twice (one row per forward-ledger date) the row dated on the report day itself is kept. The RBI's own operations in the same table are in rates-liquidity (report 8). Amounts are converted from rupees to ₹ crore. TREPS (triparty repo dealing on the Clearing Corporation of India) replaced CBLO in November 2018; the RBI's table keeps the old label.
